reasons: Deviation classification is correct: §5(a)-(c) warrant only legal compliance (knowledge-qualified), authority/rights and non-infringement; there is no conformance warranty, warranty period or repair/re-perform/refund remedy anywhere, and §5(e) disclaims implied merchantability/fitness — this fails even the fallback (90 days services with remedies).

The inserted subparagraph (f) tracks the model language closely and is the smallest edit that reaches the position: professional-and-workmanlike standard, 90-day conformance warranty to Specifications/documentation, re-performance/repair/replacement/refund remedy, plus an express carve-out from the §5(e) disclaimer per the redline guidance.

Direction and party roles are correct (Contractor warrants; Company has the remedy); §1(b)'s bare performance covenant is acknowledged rather than double-flagged, and the untouched original paragraph text is preserved.

The failed deterministic check on warranty period is a false negative — the inserted text expressly states "a period of ninety (90) days following delivery," satisfying the 90-day fallback/preferred services period.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice, correctly states what changed and why, and offers flexibility on the period length as a fallback.
